# Economy
# Allows viewing your own balance (balance, bal)
neoessentials.economy.balance
# Allows viewing other players' balances 
neoessentials.economy.balance.others
# Allows paying another player (pay)
neoessentials.economy.pay
# Allows use of all /eco admin commands (give, take, set, view others' balance/history)
neoessentials.economy.eco
# Allows viewing the balance leaderboard (baltop)
neoessentials.economy.baltop
# Allows toggling payment reception (paytoggle)
neoessentials.economy.paytoggle

# Chat/Player Commands
# Allows toggling AFK status
neoessentials.command.afk
# Allows ignoring other players
neoessentials.command.ignore
# Allows unignoring players
neoessentials.command.unignore
# Allows muting other players
neoessentials.command.mute
# Allows unmuting players
neoessentials.command.unmute
# Allows viewing the mute list
neoessentials.command.mutelist
# Allows toggling private message reception
neoessentials.command.msgtoggle
# Allows using SocialSpy to monitor private messages
neoessentials.command.socialspy
# Allows replying to the last private message
neoessentials.command.reply
